# Alberto Rota

> PhD candidate in Bioengineering at Politecnico di Milano. Research, open-source tools, and visual systems for surgical robotics and medical AI.

Site: https://www.albertorota.dev
Email: alberto1.rota@polimi.it
GitHub: https://github.com/alberto-rota
Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=VyC48nkAAAAJ

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.albertorota.dev): research, terminal tools, VS Code extensions, and design work.
- [Sitemap](https://www.albertorota.dev/sitemap.xml)

## Research

- [UnReflectAnything](https://www.albertorota.dev/research/unreflect-anything): RGB-only specular highlight removal (CVPR 2026 oral).
- [SCALE-EM](https://www.albertorota.dev/research/scale-em): self-supervised contrastive embedding adaptation for endoscopic image matching.
- [MESA](https://www.albertorota.dev/research/mesa): annotation-efficient adnexal mass segmentation in cine ultrasound.
- [Spectra-BREAST](https://www.albertorota.dev/research/spectra-breast): fiducial-based 3D hyperspectral mapping of lumpectomy specimens.
- [muVES](https://www.albertorota.dev/research/muves): 3D morphological analysis and flow estimation in microvasculature-on-a-chip.
- [STEVE](https://www.albertorota.dev/research/steve): augmented training curriculum for surgical robotics.
- [UnderXAI-OVIT](https://www.albertorota.dev/research/underxai-ovit): explainable AI for ovarian cancer treatment planning.
- [Robotic Colonoscopy](https://www.albertorota.dev/research/robotic-colonoscopy): coverage-optimal robotic colonoscopy via patient-specific digital twins.
- [Surgical AR Review](https://www.albertorota.dev/research/surgical-ar-review): survey of augmented reality for robotic applications.
